title: Harden execution evidence and trustworthy completion semantics
summary: Result Goal 1 of ISS-20260730-AE1BCC for the next reliability release line. The RC6 gate was satisfied at exact released revision 2a48486b7b8c3395d05e4f30201e968ee88f9779; T1 is ready to audit current WorkContract, Evidence Plane, finalize, merge, cleanup, and recovery behavior. The audit must preserve work_2705c12349124ed2b9b94950a427c31a as a real stale-finalization and receipt-recovery fixture before implementation begins.
goals: Introduce explicit WorkKind, DispatchState, and EvidenceState semantics with backward-compatible migration.
Bind validation and completion to the exact source revision and current repository state.
Produce a machine-readable Completion Receipt covering mutation, checks, commit, merge, cleanup, no-change outcomes, and remaining risks.
Make interrupted-session recovery idempotent and evidence-driven.
nonGoals: Do not create an autonomous planning brain or a parallel execution state model.
Do not treat agent prose as sufficient completion evidence.
Do not block legitimate completed_no_change outcomes when they are proven.
Do not begin runtime modification before ISS-20260729-BF2F89 reaches a clean terminal and merged baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Legacy WorkContract records remain readable and migrate deterministically.
A changed result cannot finalize without current-revision mutation, check, commit/integration, and cleanup evidence required by its contract.
A no-change result has a distinct, auditable completion path that proves the objective was already satisfied.
Stale or contradictory evidence prevents final completion and produces actionable recovery state.
A new session can resume a Work by stable ID without depending on chat history.
Focused and regression tests cover success, no-change, interruption, retry, stale evidence, failed check, failed merge, and cleanup recovery.

acceptanceCriteria: RC6 gate is verified complete and the source revision is recorded.

notes: Concrete audit fixture observed while solidifying the program on 2026-07-30: Work work_2705c12349124ed2b9b94950a427c31a validated and committed revision 25f40004c9f229b935fc649daaf68498eb4d4f06. Its first work_finalize merge attempt correctly refused the dirty RC6 source checkout. The same feature commit was then fast-forwarded to local main through clean checkout checkout_60a6da28cb11fcd617d282b0, the feature branch was deleted, and the managed worktree was removed. However the WorkContract retained merge=failed / branchCleanup=pending and could not produce the complete Delivery Receipt required by accept_task. Use this as a regression/audit case for exact Git fact reconciliation, idempotent staged finalization, manually completed integration detection, and receipt recovery. The invalid blank rh_work verification check is infrastructure metadata, not a product check failure.

tasks.title: Add explicit work, dispatch, and evidence state semantics with migration
tasks.objective: Implement WorkKind, DispatchState, EvidenceState, versioned persistence, and deterministic backward-compatible reads for existing Work records.
acceptanceCriteria: Old records load without destructive rewrite.
State transitions are validated and impossible combinations fail closed.
Failed migration does not overwrite known-good durable state.
notes: 2026-08-01: Added schema-v2 WorkKind, DispatchState, EvidenceState, and CompletionOutcome axes while retaining status as a compatibility projection. Schema-v1 records normalize in memory and persist v2 only on mutation; invalid outcomes/transitions fail closed. Focused state and lifecycle suites passed with typecheck.

tasks.title: Bind verification and Completion Receipts to the exact revision
tasks.objective: Record exact-revision check evidence and emit a Completion Receipt that traces objective, acceptance criteria, mutation/no-change proof, checks, commit, integration, cleanup, and residual risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Check evidence identifies source revision and verification inputs.
A later repository mutation makes earlier completion evidence stale.
Receipt fields are bounded, redacted, and machine-readable.
notes: 2026-08-01: Exact-revision verification evidence is complete. Controller Work validation records source revision, input/command fingerprints, receipt artifact identity, and timestamps; the bounded resolver marks stale source/input evidence non-current. The idempotent Controller Work receipt bridge now requires every declared check to have a current valid pass for the exact target revision.

tasks.title: Gate finalize for changed and no-change outcomes
tasks.objective: Update finalize so changed work and completed_no_change use distinct evidence gates; record failed commit, merge, or cleanup as resumable non-terminal stages.
acceptanceCriteria: Changed work cannot report complete before required integration and cleanup stages.
No-change completion requires objective-specific proof.
Retrying finalize is idempotent and resumes from the last durable stage.
notes: 2026-08-01: T4 verified. completed_no_change Receipt support requires explicit clean proof, exact revision, zero changed paths, skipped commit/merge stages, and idempotently emits delivery.kind/strategy=no_change. Manual/equivalent integration now persists a reviewer-attributed, SQLite-backed reconciliation record with original/observed revisions, reachability, bounded compared paths, unavailable stages, and cleanup proof; only explicit accepted equivalence issues a receipt without rewriting failed historical Work stages. bun run check:type plus the Work receipt/finalize recovery suite passed (23 tests).

tasks.title: Harden cross-session recovery and continuation handoff
tasks.objective: Ensure work_get, work_inspect, status digests, continuation prompts, and repair paths expose enough bounded evidence for a new session to continue safely.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh session can distinguish running, blocked, stale, integration-pending, cleanup-pending, completed, and completed_no_change.
Continuation output contains stable IDs and next safe action, not hidden chat assumptions.
No secrets or unbounded logs enter handoff payloads.
notes: 2026-08-01: T5 verified. Shared bounded continuation projection exposes stable Work/repository/request bindings, semantic axes, exact-check summaries, reconciliation outcomes, continuation prompt, and a next safe action through work_get, work_inspect, work_status_digest, rh_context, and review handoffs. Prompts are bounded then MCP-redacted before projection. Focused Work submit, session recovery, and goal-workloop tests passed.
